payload.authorization: 2026-09-15 user explicitly authorized the zero-oracle expanded balanced compositional structural-subgoal generator revision
payload.scientific_problem: Test whether adding the separately sealed delta-0.6 structural-route supervision improves the frozen compositional patch generator under an otherwise identical held-source protocol.
payload.primary_model_output: The unchanged baseline address-free source-region distribution pi(R|x), followed by its unchanged conditional autoregressive distribution over one complete local target patch H, attachments alpha and dependencies D.
payload.central_claim_under_test: Adding exact delta-0.6 COMPOSE witness routes with explicit domain/source/route/component/decision balancing improves held-source structural proposal quality without changing model, support, compiler, budget, metric or gate.
payload.evaluation_setting: The same three frozen whole-source folds over the same 77-route T4 held-source evaluator. Training adds only 32 exact delta-0.6 routes and 45 subgoals to the baseline 77 T4, 55 Full-146-extra and 85 converted PMO traces.

training_census.duplicate_policy: one canonical source-endpoint pair is one route; retain tied references as provenance only with no repeated training mass

split.t4_auxiliary_rule: admit Full-146 and delta-0.6 routes only when their source belongs to the T4 training fold
split.pmo_rule: admit only the same 85 exactly converted PMO routes as the baseline and keep them training-only

generated_object.region: The address-free set of source roles referenced by the first local construction event.
generated_object.target_patch: The complete before-to-after graph delta extracted after one or two mutually local generic construction events.
generated_object.attachments: Every generated source-to-created or created-to-created target edge, emitted inside the same event sequence.
generated_object.dependencies: Ordered created-role and shared-role dependencies induced by the same event sequence, not a separately predicted label.

model.region_features: address-free element, degree, bond, cycle and global graph summaries
model.joint_event_features: one vector containing rule, all relative structural operands, typed parameters, current graph, selected region, prior event and partial-patch state
model.event_support: all exact legal Active8 successors admitted by the unchanged generic executor fiber; no finite whole-patch vocabulary
model.locality: after the first event, later events must reference the fixed source region or a role created or changed by the partial patch
model.fit: closed-form weighted diagonal Gaussian moments with a fixed variance floor; no neural accelerator training
model.weights: equal domain mass; within domain equal source or task-family mass; within source equal route mass; within route equal component and decision mass
model.checkpoint_contents: numeric moments, generic support/configuration and input hashes only

decoder.uniform_tie_break: canonical successor key then action serialization

evaluation.teacher_injection: not used; if added later it must be a separately labelled rank diagnostic

acceptance.learned_improvement_gate: At K=32 or K=128, the learned arm must strictly improve the uniform arm on source-balanced held-teacher component coverage or transformation-equivalent recall, with no loss of exact-realization precision.

payload.negative_result_policy: A failed matched improvement or teacher-recovery gate remains an authoritative negative result and does not authorize a model, support, budget, metric or gate change.
payload.interpretation_limit: This gate establishes only the effect of a sealed training-data expansion on zero-oracle held-source structural generation. It does not establish molecular utility, docking improvement, autonomous optimization or an IVG comparison.
